semantics.canonical_role: repository-scoped governed specification and work-execution engine

requirements.title: workspace identity — behavior
requirements.statement: The system shall provide workspace identity as an observable work-execution behavior consistent with AgilePlus's canonical execution authority.

verification_intent.positive_oracle: Demonstrate workspace identity on exact scoped work identities and retain attributable execution evidence.
verification_intent.negative_oracle: Exercise a conflicting, stale, unauthorized, missing-evidence, wrong-scope, or invalid workspace identity case and prove no false green/transition occurs.

requirements.title: workspace identity — identity
requirements.statement: The system shall bind workspace identity to stable workspace/project/feature/work-package/actor/revision identities sufficient to prevent cross-scope attribution.

verification_intent.positive_oracle: Demonstrate workspace identity on exact scoped work identities and retain attributable execution evidence.
verification_intent.negative_oracle: Exercise a conflicting, stale, unauthorized, missing-evidence, wrong-scope, or invalid workspace identity case and prove no false green/transition occurs.

requirements.title: workspace identity — boundary
requirements.statement: The system shall reject or explicitly classify unauthorized, contradictory, stale, invalid, or out-of-scope workspace identity operations rather than silently succeeding.

verification_intent.positive_oracle: Demonstrate workspace identity on exact scoped work identities and retain attributable execution evidence.

verification_intent.positive_oracle: Demonstrate journey grading on exact scoped work identities and retain attributable execution evidence.
verification_intent.negative_oracle: Exercise a conflicting, stale, unauthorized, missing-evidence, wrong-scope, or invalid journey grading case and prove no false green/transition occurs.
